constraints: Inventory source reads and subsequent native drafts are recorded separately. This workstream has performed no Git publication, portal/account mutation, production gameplay/contribution write or new device activity for these drafts.

sharedNativeContract.graphics: Bundle or cache the original project graphics with provenance. Native vector rendering must support each asset actual paths, transforms and clipping. Use native text/shape drawing for card pips; there is no card image deck.
sharedNativeContract.links: Shared handler validates http/https or explicit first-party actions such as tel, reports UIApplication.open failure, and opens external services only after a tap. HTTPS allows installed-app universal links and browser fallback. Do not infer successful app install or external account login from opening a URL.
sharedNativeContract.externalBrowsing: SFSafariViewController is an optional visible modal browser for external resources. It is not a replacement for first-party native screens, and web interactions/data are not accessible to the app.
sharedNativeContract.authentication: Directory reads and local games are public. Admin writes require auth:web,sanctum plus exact server capabilities. Guess Who uses a separate guest room identity. External services retain separate accounts.
sharedNativeContract.tests: Native acceptance requires iPhone 17 light/dark rendering plus real interaction for each first-party screen. Reused engines need deterministic existing invariants; imported graphics need visible comparison. This inventory makes no native parity completion claim.
sharedNativeContract.publicPageTransport: Accepted root contract: api.page<T>(path, expectedComponent, decode, {params, signal}) validates public Inertia JSON props, bootstraps the current version, bounds a version refresh, and omits credentials. Root verified the live transport. Use native UI; no WebView or webpage rendering.

features: One human seat and three local heuristic AI seats, in opposite-seat partnerships. No network multiplayer.
Deal 13 cards per seat. Auction opens to the dealer left, bids 7 through 13, pass is legal, and all-pass redeals.
High bidder selects trump, leads, and all seats must follow suit when possible. Highest trump wins, otherwise highest led suit wins.
Pause after a completed trick until the human continues; show played cards and winning seat.
Made contract scores tricks taken. Failed contract awards the bid to defenders.
Kaboot 13 made scores 26. Failed kaboot costs declarer 16 and awards defenders twice their tricks. A sweep on a lower bid earns 3 extra. First team to 41 wins.
AI estimates trump strength, chooses a legal bid/trump/play and avoids taking a safe partner trick. AI delay is 750 ms.
Show live team/trick/auction state, match statistics sheet, options, new game, rules, card style, tap-select/play and card drag.
Persist finished-match win/loss/played totals and shared card display preference, not active match state.

features: One human and three local AI seats play 20 deals: four kingdoms, five distinct contracts in each kingdom. No network multiplayer.
First kingdom belongs to the seat dealt seven of hearts; kingdom holder sees their hand before choosing a remaining contract.
Contracts are queens, diamonds, tricks, king of hearts and trix. Four avoidance contracts have no trump and enforce following suit.
Queen penalty is 25, diamond penalty 10, trick penalty 15 and king-of-hearts penalty 75. Hearts cannot lead king-of-hearts unless the hand contains only hearts.
Trix lays suit runs from jacks upward to ace and downward to two. Pass is legal only when no legal lay exists. Finishing order pays 200, 150, 100 and 50.
Support individual and opposite-seat partnership modes. Show standings, contract/kingdom, deal result, next deal and final result.
AI chooses a suitable remaining contract, ducks/sheds penalties, spares its partner in team mode and plays legal shedding cards. AI delay is 700 ms.
Tap-select/play and drag cards, continue after trick, change shared card display, view rules/stats/options, and start a fresh game.
Persist finished-match statistics and card display preference. Current kingdom, hands, totals and mode are not persisted across a page reload.
Doubling and early deal termination are not implemented in the source.

features: Create a room using an active category with at least 12 characters, or mix/random. Room has up to 24 characters and a UUID room code.
Share/copy room URL or enter a room code, join as one of two guest session identities, and reject a third player/full room.
Choose and confirm a private secret character. Both ready selections start play, with player 1 taking the first turn.
Eliminate and restore character cards on a private board; server stores eliminated IDs per player and broadcasts only remaining counts.
Player on turn may pass or confirm a character guess. Correct guess wins; wrong guess passes turn. Server owns legality, turn and winner.
Resume/rejoin fetches own secret, eliminations, opponent remaining count and authoritative status. Presence shows opponent connection state.
Laravel Reverb presence channel guesswho.{roomCode}, event .state. Channel authorization requires membership in a room player slot.
Finished room remains finished; play-again returns to lobby to create a new room. No rematch/reset action or AI opponent exists.
Spoken questions use an external voice/video channel; the game has no implemented audio/video calling or text-question API.
Guest identity is browser-tab scoped in the website, separate from a signed-in account.
